claims.statement: The industrial vacancy rate in the Meridian Corridor as of the second quarter of 2025 was 4.1%, down from 5.6% a year earlier.

citations.quote: Industrial vacancy within the Meridian Corridor fell to 4.1% as of the second quarter of 2025, down from 5.6% a year earlier, on net absorption of approximately 1.9 million square feet against 1.2 million square feet of new deliveries.
